Downgrade MRS only to Unresolved (mandatory_reporting: Unresolved; keep VTS side as not established). NGA Pub. 124 (Sector 8 pp.247-248) text confirmed: vessels must inform the Maritime Authority in Punta Arenas on entering or leaving the Estrecho de Magallanes and report position every 4 h (0800/2000 with pilot), 'This position report (CHILREP)'. But: (1) there is no formally named mandatory scheme; the only named scheme, CHILREP, is expressly voluntary per DIRECTEMAR ('El CHILREP es un sistema voluntario', p.5), and the mandatory element is an unnamed 'reglamentacion nacional' for foreign ships in internal waters (12:00Z/24:00Z), which conflicts with NGA's 4-hourly/0800-2000 regime; (2) the one legal basis I could trace, cited in DIRECTEMAR Circular Maritima Gobernacion Maritima de Valdivia 01/2012, is D.S. (M) 1190 of 1976 Title III, which makes entry position/plan and 0800/2000 daily reports compulsory for foreign ships only 'por razones de reciprocidad' (ships of States imposing equivalent duties on Chilean ships), plus a flag-only duty for Chilean ships under D.S. (M) 392 of 2001 art. 63; neither is shown to be an unconditional penal duty on all ships in the TSS, which is the project test used for MASTREP; (3) no Strait-specific DIRECTEMAR instrument was found (Circular O-80/009 covers Beagle-Cabo de Hornos, not the Strait; Res. 12600/465 of 2023 for Bahia Catalina, Punta Arenas, sets a 24 h anchorage request, a port duty). The Strait reporting is area-based, not port or flag-only, so it is a strong lead, but existence, legal basis and terms cannot be classified safely under the prompt's Step 6 (sources conflict; authoritative documentation not located).
